title: ul_board partition payload
description: The JSON stored after the 16-byte header in the ul_board partition (see board-partition.md). Board descriptor plus one-time provisioning data.

token.description: One-time enrollment token. Absent when only the descriptor is being rewritten on an already-enrolled node.

server.description: Host name for HTTPS enrollment and MQTT. lights.evm100.org in production; a dev host name on the bench. Never an IP.

server_ca.description: Optional. Trust this CA for the server instead of the built-in public CA bundle. For dev servers without a Let's Encrypt certificate.

dns.description: Optional DNS server applied after every DHCP lease, e.g. 192.168.1.99.
